reason: Readiness/hazard/source review covers17physical packages and19open gates. The new governing wheel-reaction and sidebearer-contact gaps now have bounded reproducible tools. No further useful actual part/connection definition is supportable from current controlled interfaces and accepted design inputs. Additional arbitrary sensitivities, copied references or schematic HOLD drawings would not close the owner buildability deficiency.

first_unlock_sequence.subject: Coordinated custom wheelset / bearing / axlebox definition
first_unlock_sequence.accountable: Qualified rail-vehicle running-gear engineer with wheel/bearing manufacturers and specialist machinist
first_unlock_sequence.required: Controlled wheel/rail profile and back-to-back/contact geometry; wheel material and axle joint; axle journal/shoulder/retention geometry; exact bearing arrangement with fits, axial location, lubrication/seals, allowable articulation and load ratings; nonrotating axlebox mating/guide faces. Document revision and units. Nominal gauge and G1 display sizes are insufficient.
first_unlock_sequence.unlocks: Common physical source for wheelset, axlebox, guides and D1 stationary carrier.

first_unlock_sequence.subject: Exact delivered D1 mating hardware and behavior
first_unlock_sequence.accountable: Brake manufacturer/application specialist plus running-gear engineer; physical samples may be measured under a controlled inspection plan
first_unlock_sequence.required: Exact Dexter12.25x4 PQ assembly/handing; drum pilot, bolt pattern, all mounting faces, OD/depth and service-removal envelope; cam bearing/spline/slack/chamber support geometry; exact20/24 chamber mounting, force/stroke, spring force/hold/release and air-volume data; direction-specific brake torque/pressure and low-torque modulation evidence. Do not scale photos or substitute friction size. Retain drum mounting-face orientation and remove hub/drum together while wheel/bearing remain.
first_unlock_sequence.unlocks: Custom removable hub joint, spider/carrier, cam/chamber bracket and nonbinding torque reaction; final pneumatic sizing including separate locomotive package.

first_unlock_sequence.subject: Accepted whole-truck load, motion and support basis
first_unlock_sequence.accountable: Qualified rail-vehicle structural/dynamics engineer coordinating actual coach layout and controlled components
first_unlock_sequence.required: Empty/occupied mass and CG ledger including complete truck; wheelbase/spans and actual spring stations; permitted axlebox articulation/travel and guide/reaction constraints; body center-bearing/pivot/sidebearer contact law; full-coach twist/roll/stability and combined braking/lateral/wind/load spectrum; actual coil force/deflection/free/solid envelopes and damper force/velocity/angular/travel limits. Explicit load state for floor height. S2/S3 synthetic constants are not selections.
first_unlock_sequence.unlocks: Spring seats, guides, dampers/stops/retention, truck frame/crossmember and coach bolster mounts as one coordinated custom assembly.

first_unlock_sequence.subject: Downstream actual equipment / fabrication interfaces
first_unlock_sequence.accountable: Vehicle structural/accessibility/electrical/HVAC engineers and qualified fabricator
first_unlock_sequence.required: Actual seat foot and floor-panel insert/closeout design with fit-up and movement; separate accessible frame/load map, boarding equipment and evacuation method; selected doors/glazing/emergency retention, HVAC exact mounting/cutout/base loads, stairs/platform stow and locks. Adopted structural/fire/accessibility/electrical criteria and material/joint/fatigue/WPS/inspection basis. Use existing package-specific registers rather than duplicate forms.
first_unlock_sequence.unlocks: Actual body, floor, accessible frame, roof/HVAC, stair and guard connection drawings.

first_unlock_sequence.subject: Site and authority evidence
first_unlock_sequence.accountable: Licensed surveyor, track/civil designers, responsible authorities and insurer as applicable
first_unlock_sequence.required: Survey control, terrain/alignment and verified grades/crosslevels; soils/drainage, crossings/clearances, actual matched rail/joint/fastening interfaces; confirmed jurisdiction/adopted requirements; stations and boarding load states coordinated to vehicle. North Pole location remains owner-deferred and need not precede running-gear engineering.
first_unlock_sequence.unlocks: Actual track/stations/civil drawings and project-specific installation/commissioning criteria.

package_specific_outstanding_inputs.subject: Regular-coach underframe J1a
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.exact_missing_definition: End planes are not saw lengths. Register explicitly excludes I-BA angles, I-BT boxes, I-SH1 hardpoints, weld solids, bogie mounts, couplings and brakes. No released joints, WPS, local-wall/fatigue acceptance or complete assembled frame.
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.responsible_disciplines: Vehicle structural engineer + qualified fabricator/welding and inspection specialists
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.existing_next_work: Reconcile every connection ID to one actual detail and drawing; integrate accepted supports and loads before machining/cutting release.

package_specific_outstanding_inputs.subject: Local frame connections I1
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.exact_missing_definition: 160 mesh objects are not160 purchasable or fabricated parts. These details are NOT installed in the110-member J1a model. Represented weld volumes are not accepted weld sizes/procedures or demonstrated capacity.
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.responsible_disciplines: Vehicle structural engineer + welding engineer + fabricator
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.existing_next_work: Complete one load-path connection after its receiving members, stiffness, design loads, fit-up and inspection basis are accepted.

package_specific_outstanding_inputs.subject: Accessible coach structure and seat/boarding layout
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.exact_missing_definition: Do not copy regular-coach seat feet/support schedule into this car. No accepted wheelchair/lift point loads, independent accessible frame/joint schedule or signed occupied circulation/evacuation result. Sparse DXF labels require the coordinate table. Different source floor datums must not be interpreted as one accepted geometry.
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.existing_next_work: Use existing full-size mockup protocol; map actual accepted seat, wheelchair, boarding and evacuation loads to a separate support schedule. Do not issue a duplicate mockup.

package_specific_outstanding_inputs.subject: Complete two-axle coach truck
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.exact_missing_definition: G1 596mm wheels,1165mm wheelbase,2in axle and displayed hardware are not selected sizes. No complete physical axlebox, guide, spring/damper, stops/retention, frame, pivot/sidebearer or brake assembly has been defined.
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.responsible_disciplines: Rail vehicle/running-gear and dynamics engineers + bearing/brake/spring suppliers
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.existing_next_work: Close wheel/bearing/axlebox package and masses, then compatible guide articulation, brake reaction and twist/roll response; actual spring/damper envelopes precede mount sizes.

package_specific_outstanding_inputs.subject: Rail wheels, rotating axles and removable drum hubs
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.exact_missing_definition: No selected rail profile/back-to-back/wear limits, wheel-seat fit, axle fatigue/retention detail or hub joint. A semi-trailer stationary spindle arrangement cannot be copied onto a rotating rail axle.
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.responsible_disciplines: Wheelset/rail contact engineer + specialist wheel/axle manufacturer and NDT inspector
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.existing_next_work: Complete exact wheel/rail and bearing arrangements before selecting journal, wheel-seat, hub-joint and machining fits; never derive dimensions from screenshots.

package_specific_outstanding_inputs.subject: D1 installed coach brakes and custom supports
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.exact_missing_definition: L2-M01/M02/M03 are schematics, not fabrication drawings. Exact drum/pilot/holes, spider/cam/chamber envelopes, maximum torque curves, reverse modulation, custom hub/carrier/reaction geometry remain held. Locomotive package is separate.
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.responsible_disciplines: Brake/running-gear engineers + Dexter/application evidence + qualified fabricator
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.existing_next_work: Use controlled delivered D1 interfaces and full service/spring/fault torque with axlebox/guide motions; do not add an independently rigid reaction that locks suspension.

package_specific_outstanding_inputs.subject: Air trainlines, control and stored energy
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.exact_missing_definition: Functional topology is not a final port/plumbing or safety-controller implementation. Catalog volume sums do not validate charging, separation response, trapped pressure, brake balance, emergency timing or holding.
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.responsible_disciplines: Rail brake/control engineer + pneumatic application specialists
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.existing_next_work: Freeze actual locomotive+coach valves/chambers, lengths/volumes and power allocation; prepare instrumented full-consist failure tests with accepted limits before operation.

package_specific_outstanding_inputs.subject: Drawbar DB-01 and frame coupling joints
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.exact_missing_definition: No released eye fit, retainers, pins/clevises, draft gear, frame attachment, secondary restraint or full-motion guards. Nominal DXF is not an NC cutting file; bearing catalog ratings are not coupling allowable loads.
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.existing_next_work: Close complete pin/clevis/bearing/retention and frame load path under tension, compression, slack, fatigue and accepted articulation; then revise part and actual drawings.

package_specific_outstanding_inputs.subject: Locomotive frame, powered running gear and propulsion
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.exact_missing_definition: Not exact order codes or a construction-ready drive. No accepted continuous installed engine duty, complete powered chassis, supported reduction, adapter, mounts, cooling/exhaust, tank endurance or operator visibility envelope.
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.existing_next_work: Obtain exact shaft/housing/continuous maps and vehicle arrangement; coordinate motor/reduction/axle relative motion and exhaust/cooling with occupied cars before physical adapter/frame detail.

package_specific_outstanding_inputs.subject: Floor panels, seat hardpoints and seams
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.exact_missing_definition: No accepted stack with positive tolerance/load/thermal clearance, panel inserts/edge closeouts, fastener grip/locking, movement topology or moisture-qualified joint. Accessible car requires its own mapping.
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.existing_next_work: Resolve actual coupled hardpoint/panel stack and load bypass, then one exact production-material seat/panel coupon with defined proof/cyclic/thermal/wet acceptance.

package_specific_outstanding_inputs.subject: Body, doors, glazing and historical locomotive shell
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.exact_missing_definition: No complete physical wall/roof framing or skin joints, glazing retention, door mechanism/interlocks, fire/material basis, drainage/weather seal or locomotive historical shell fabrication set. Appearance does not resolve structural or evacuation details.
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.responsible_disciplines: Vehicle/body structural and materials engineers + door/glazing specialists
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.existing_next_work: Define actual sections and load-bearing door/roof/HVAC rings from accepted packaging; coordinate emergency openings, weathering and maintainable joints.

package_specific_outstanding_inputs.subject: HVAC, outside air and roof mounting
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.exact_missing_definition: No selected unit counts or roof ring/fasteners. Linked opening/clearance variants require exact configuration closure. Recirculation is not outside air; roof projection/headroom and condensate routes remain coordinated design inputs.
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.responsible_disciplines: HVAC/electrical + body structural engineers and actual HVAC supplier
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.existing_next_work: Accept climate/occupancy/door/ventilation duty and exact unit/ADB manual; complete support, gasket stack, intake/exhaust separation and real ventilation paths.

package_specific_outstanding_inputs.subject: Hotel supply, DC reserve and electrical installation
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.exact_missing_definition: No selected generator/battery/charger, one-line, wire/breaker sizes, connector pinout, fault/bond/neutral regime or emergency-light duration. Hydraulic DC-B07 pump load is superseded in current configuration.
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.responsible_disciplines: Electrical engineer + brake/HVAC/propulsion engineers and authority
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.existing_next_work: Consolidate actual nameplate/start/fault loads and supply assignment; complete distribution, moving connections, bonding, isolation and cold/aged reserve with engineer-set tests.

package_specific_outstanding_inputs.subject: End platforms, stairs, guards and boarding
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.exact_missing_definition: No accepted loaded floor range, physical stair mechanism/stow lock, hinge/frame mounts, guards/gates or moving clearance.7inrise/11ingoing benchmark is not an adopted vehicle code.44in platform is only a reservation.
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.responsible_disciplines: Vehicle/boarding structural and accessibility designers + responsible authority
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.existing_next_work: Set actual stopped/traveling modes and mechanism, floor states, loads and accepted boarding criteria before hinges/bolts/welds; do not redraw the existing mockup as new fabrication.

package_specific_outstanding_inputs.subject: Track, formation, crossings and stations
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.exact_missing_definition: No actual survey/site route/soil/drainage design, selected rail/ties/fasteners or turnout/crossing/station construction set.30ASCE linkedIGES is quarantined:88.9mm versus79.375mm paper height/base.
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.responsible_disciplines: Licensed survey/civil + track/vehicle engineers and authority
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.existing_next_work: Complete real ground-level survey/datum and track/vehicle compatibility; freeze matched rail/joint/fastening and accepted proof-section design before installation release.

package_specific_outstanding_inputs.subject: Fabrication methods, traceability and installation
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.exact_missing_definition: Blank forms are not completed inspection, qualified WPS/PQR, material certification or accepted as-built records. No safety-critical shop work is authorized by source availability.
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.existing_next_work: Create consolidated per-assembly manufacturing/inspection plan using existing forms, after accepted drawing revision; define hold/witness points without inventing acceptance values.

package_specific_outstanding_inputs.subject: Operations, maintenance, emergency response and commissioning
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.exact_missing_definition: No signed operating rulebook, staffing qualifications, dispatch/separation scheme, brake/evacuation acceptance values, actual test results or authority/insurance operating acceptance. Future second-train service is not cleared.
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.responsible_disciplines: Operator/owner + responsible vehicle/track/control engineers + authority/emergency/insurer roles as applicable
package_specific_outstanding_inputs.existing_next_work: Complete integrated pre-service/shift/defect/emergency and staged commissioning development using controlled actual configuration; existing blank records must not be republished as test results.
